description: This file implements replay functionality for the Battle for Wesnoth game, including replay management, command recording, and replay execution logic.

classes.name: replay
classes.description: Class managing replay command recording, playback, and data management.

classes.name: replay_network_sender
classes.description: Class responsible for sending replay data over the network.

classes.name: verification_manager
classes.description: Class for verifying unit data consistency during replays.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies that the unit structure matches the provided configuration.

methods.name: create_verification
methods.description: Creates a configuration snapshot of the current units for verification.

methods.name: verify_units
methods.description: Performs verification of units against a configuration.

methods.name: make_verify_units
methods.description: Generates a verification configuration for current units.

methods.name: replay::replay
methods.description: Constructor initializing replay with a given configuration.

methods.name: replay::set_save_info
methods.description: Sets the saved game state info.

methods.name: replay::get_save_info
methods.description: Returns the saved game state info.

methods.name: replay::set_skip
methods.description: Sets the number of turns to skip in replay.

methods.name: replay::save_game
methods.description: Saves the current game state and replay data.

methods.name: replay::add_start
methods.description: Adds a start command to the replay.

methods.name: replay::add_value
methods.description: Records a command with an integer value.

methods.name: replay::build_chat_log
methods.description: Builds a chat log string from replay commands.

methods.name: replay::get_data_range
methods.description: Retrieves a range of commands for data transmission.

methods.name: replay::add_command
methods.description: Adds a new command to the replay.

methods.name: replay::get_next_action
methods.description: Gets the next command for playback.

methods.name: replay::pre_replay
methods.description: Prepares replay by skipping start commands.

methods.name: replay::at_end
methods.description: Checks if replay has reached the end.

methods.name: replay::empty
methods.description: Checks if replay has no commands.

methods.name: do_replay
methods.description: Executes the replay sequence, applying commands to the game state.

methods.name: replay_network_sender::replay_network_sender
methods.description: Constructor for network sender, initializes with replay object.

methods.name: replay_network_sender::commit_and_sync
methods.description: Sends all commands over network and updates state.
